subject: Post-call: CloudWise renewal + scaling options (usage review & next steps)
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@cloudwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: CloudWise renewal + scaling options (usage review & next steps)

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call so we have alignment and clear next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of what we heard from CloudWise:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency during peak chat sessions (p95 currently ~420ms) and bring predictable per-token costs under committed capacity.
- New workloads: conversational real-time chat (low latency) + embedding-driven semantic search for product catalog updates (high throughput embeddings).
- Pain points: bursty traffic causing tail latency spikes, cost variability across models, and a desire for simpler rollbacks during model upgrades.
- Renewal window: mid-January 2027 (they are targeting a signed agreement by 2027-01-15).

Proposed expansion path (high-level):
1) Move high-volume embedding traffic to a Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commit) to reduce unit cost and provide predictable throughput.
2) Keep latency-sensitive chat on a smaller reserved pool with autoscale + prefix caching to hit target p95 <200ms.
3) Cross-model fallback policy + canary rollouts to limit risk during model swaps.

Immediate next steps (action items):
- Rishi (me): share Q3 usage export and an initial capacity/price sketch (attached: usage_report_Q3.csv).
- Marissa: prepare a draft quote and preliminary contract language for a 12-month committed capacity (cut for procurement).
- Aditya: prepare a short migration checklist for SSO, audit logs, and KV cache warmup notes.
- Sophie / Joe: confirm expected committed throughput for embeddings and concurrent-chat sessions by 2026-11-08.

I'd like to schedule a 45-minute follow-up next week to review the draft quote and the migration checklist — does 2026-11-10 or 2026-11-11 work for you?

Attachments: usage_report_Q3.csv (summary export).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@cloudwise.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Joe Lin <joe.lin@cloudwise.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: CloudWise renewal + scaling options (usage review & next steps)

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the clear recap — that aligns with what we discussed. A couple notes from our side:
- Procurement preference: 12-month committed capacity if pricing looks favorable.
- We’ll need line items for Dedicated embeddings pool (estimated 200k embed units/day) and chat pool (peak concurrent users ~120, typical concurrency 40).
- Security: our InfoSec will want a quick note on SSO (SAML 2.0), audit logs retention (90 days), and SOC 2 artifacts — can Aditya include that in the migration checklist?

Joe (cc) is our CTO and will review the quote. If possible, include an option for a 6-month phased ramp so we can test the Dedicated pool with a portion of traffic before full cutover.

We can do 2026-11-11 10:00 AM ET for the follow-up. Please send a calendar invite.

— Sophie
Sophie Martin
Head of Platform, CloudWise Inc.
sophie.martin@cloudwise.com | +1 (617) 555-0143

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@cloudwise.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Draft quote & timeline for CloudWise renewal (attached)

Hi Sophie —

Per Rishi’s recap, attaching a draft quote for a 12-month committed plan plus an optional 6-month phased ramp. High-level line items included:
- Dedicated embeddings pool: baseline commit (200k embed units/day) + overage pricing.
- Dedicated chat pool: baseline concurrent capacity for 40 with burst buffer to 120.
- One-time migration support (SRE assistance + runbook) and Access/SSO integration.
- Optional 6-month ramp: 50% traffic on Dedicated for months 1–3, then 75% months 4–6.

Attachment: draft_quote_renewal_2026.pdf

Next steps:
- If this looks reasonable, we can generate a DocuSign with the final numbers and a statement of work.
- Rishi — can you confirm the exact committed token/unit counts so I can lock the pricing?

Thanks — will send a calendar invite for 11/11 10:00 AM ET (Sophie confirmed).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0122

Marissa: once I send final counts I think the draft_quote_renewal_2026.pdf is in shape — happy to include the phased ramp option as discussed.

Thanks,
Rishi
